data_fields.name: steps
data_fields.donor_constant: Std.int(duration / interval) ticks (floor); last tick not drawn

data_fields.name: amplitude_basis
data_fields.donor_constant: object.width on both axes (y also uses width)

best_idea: A hit impact is a short decaying offset on the struck thing, with intensity and duration as data, that always returns to its rest position on completion and on stop.
decision_why: Impact feedback is client-only presentation under the one-engine rule; the decay recipe and restore-on-end/stop are clean and tunable, but the sprite-position form and the ignore-second-call rule do not fit (we need max-of-intensity and a visual-only offset).
acceptance: A landed heavy hit shakes the struck fighter's presentation offset for 0.3 s, intensity falling fastest at the start and reaching zero at the end, and the offset returns exactly to rest; a client test asserts offset equals rest after completion and after stop(), and a stronger hit during a shake raises the intensity instead of being ignored.
